protocol.status: Retrospective fixed protocol; not a prospectively sealed or blinded study

temporal.estimator: Unweighted arithmetic mean of development-year published median fractions per measure
temporal.metric: Absolute error in percentage points of held-out cohort median, not household error

epc.identity: Union of UPRN, building reference and normalised complete address+postcode; no certificate fallback
epc.repeated_certificates: Deduplicate exact certificate records, fail on conflicting duplicates, group all identities before retaining latest certificate per property
epc.labels: Mapped positive EPC recommendations are a reference only; missing recommendations are not negative labels
epc.metric: Positive recommendation agreement, mapping coverage and exclusions, never causal suitability accuracy

products.target: Reject certified kiosk records as domestic retrofit configurations
products.limitation: Only one held-out certificate holder; rule checks are not product-performance prediction or independent certificate authenticity verification

portfolio.oracle: Independent combination enumeration and constraint checks, sharing declared production benefit functions

limitations: Retrospective fixed split; historical table was already present and inspected. Not a blinded or prospectively registered test.
All years re-estimated within the same 2026 release/methodology. Distinct installation-year cohorts do not prove property-disjoint data or independent sampling.
Aggregate median stability only: nine correlated measure-year cells, not nine households. No personal or causal-effect accuracy, interval coverage or significance claimed.
Estimator is a transfer diagnostic; production published group effects are unchanged.

epc_suitability.reason: Official bulk downloads and API bearer token require GOV.UK One Login; no authorised certificate/recommendation exports supplied.

unseen_product_checks.limitations: Only one held-out certificate holder; rule checks are not product-performance prediction or independent certificate authenticity verification

cannot_externally_validate: Individual causal retrofit savings or personal uncertainty coverage from aggregate NEED tables.
Whole-property flood loss reduction, product-specific field reliability, avoided repair cost or recovery time from certification and selected case studies.
Material-specific lifecycle carbon or energy gains without appropriate verified thermal/EPD data.
Grant/insurance entitlement, installed fit or structural safety from a directory entry.
Property-grouped and region-held-out reference agreement until authorised linked EPC records are available.
